s.note: the wedding receptions Robbie sings at
s.how: Simmer 24 cocktail franks for 3 minutes and drain. Cut puff pastry into strips and roll one around each frank. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce at the reception.
Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and sliced spring onion. Shape into one big ball, roll in chopped walnuts and chill for an hour. Serve with crackers on a doily, eighties party style.

m.note: Robbie's singing lessons for Rosie, paid in meatballs
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, grated parmesan, chopped parsley, breadcrumbs and an egg. Roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti, the way Grandma Rosie pays for lessons.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam, ice white with buttercream and scatter silver cachous over the top.

d.how: Pour 1L pineapple juice and 1L orange juice into a big punch bowl. Add sliced oranges and plenty of ice, then top with 1L cold lemonade. Leave a ladle in the bowl and set out cups for the guests on the dance floor.
